verdict.rationale: Turso is a database platform, not an agentic runtime or assistant that consumes tools from MCP servers; its MCP integration works the opposite way (docs-9, docs-37, probe-4) — Turso exposes an MCP server so external AI agents can manage Turso via MCP, not the other way around. Plugging MCP servers into Turso to give it tool-use capability is a category error for this product type.
